scripts.desktop:dev: cross-env VIGILENS_START_BACKEND=true SECRET_KEY=vigilens-local-development-key-change-me VIGILENS_FRONTEND_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5199 concurrently -k "npm run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5199 --strictPort" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5199 && electron ."
scripts.admin:dev: cross-env VIGILENS_START_BACKEND=true SECRET_KEY=vigilens-local-development-key-change-me VIGILENS_DESKTOP_MODE=admin VIGILENS_FRONTEND_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5199 concurrently -k "npm run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5199 --strictPort" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5199 && electron ."
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && npm run server:build && electron-builder
scripts.server:build: .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m PyInstaller --noconfirm --clean --onefile --name vigilens-server --distpath dist-server --workpath build-server --specpath build-server server_entry.py
scripts.admin:build: npm run build && npm run server:build && electron-builder --config.extraMetadata.main=electron/admin.cjs --config.productName=Vigilens Admin --config.appId=com.vigilens.admin --config.directories.output=release-admin
